name: dot-pattern
title: Dot Pattern
description: A dotted backdrop for dark sections where each dot slowly breathes brighter and fades again on its own timing, and the whole field dissolves into black at the edges.
use: A dark hero or panel wants gentle texture and depth behind its text.
avoid: Behind small body text: the dots compete with thin glyphs and hurt reading.
a11y: The SVG is marked aria-hidden and carries no content; the endless twinkle ignores prefers-reduced-motion. (keyboard: n-a, labels: n-a, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A near-black stage covered in a regular field of tiny white dots that thins to black toward the edges. A large white heading and two centred grey lines of copy sit over the dots.
behaves: Individual dots slowly swell and brighten before shrinking back, each on its own random delay and duration, so the field twinkles instead of beating in unison.
customise: Spacing, offsets and dot radius are props; toggle the glow with a flag and set the dot colour through a text class.
weight: heavy: Roughly a thousand SVG circles, each animated by the motion library at once.
demo: The centred heading reads "Dot Pattern" above a two-line description of the background.
polishWhy: Even, well-masked dot field with a believable twinkle; the small caption is faint.
